title: a copybook that COPYs another: the copybook's own layout ignores the nested bytes (the program's view is right)

checks.sql: SELECT offset FROM field f JOIN member m ON m.id=f.member_id WHERE m.name='R06OUTER' AND f.name='R06-AFTER'
SELECT offset FROM pfield f JOIN program p ON p.id=f.program_id WHERE p.program_id='R06PGM' AND f.name='R06-AFTER'
